jobs.name: Listing correspondence
jobs.prompt: Handle the user's correspondence with listing agents. The pre-run script has already recorded new replies and found the contact requests and replies that need you. Follow the contact skill: run its work command and handle every listing it lists, then stop. Nobody reads your final response. Anything the user must know goes through the contact skill's ask or tell commands.

jobs.name: Listing search
jobs.prompt: Above is the report of this hour's apartment search. If it lists listings that wait for a judgment of the must-haves, judge them as the search skill's section "Judging must-haves" says, and keep going with the next batch from pending until none waits. Do not contact anyone and do not change any settings. End with one line saying how many listings you judged.

jobs.name: Listing features
jobs.prompt: Above is the report of the listing features job. Follow the listing-features skill: run every extraction task in the report as its section "Running extraction tasks" says. Then, if the report says notes or stated preferences wait for a reading, read them as its section "Reading notes and preferences" says. Then, if listings wait for judgments of preferences, judge them as its section "Judging preferences stated later" says, until none waits. Never look at a listing's photos yourself. Do not contact listing agents and do not change any settings. End with one line saying how many listings were extracted, how many notes and preferences were read and how many listings were judged.

jobs.name: Ranking review
jobs.prompt: Above is the report of the ranking review job. Follow the ranking skill's section "Review pass": read the review task file the report names with read_file, write the review it asks for and save it with the command it gives, then stop. If the report shows a script error instead of a task file, report that error to the user through the messaging gateway and stop. Do not contact anyone else, do not change any settings and run no other ranking command. End with the one line the task file asks for.
